Fingerprint is not available right now. Use your PIN.

Not available. It may be disabled or uninstalled.

This is your home screen app. Locking it can make it hard to get to your other apps.
This is your phone app. Locking it can get in the way of making or answering calls.
This is the Settings app. Locking it stops others from switching this app off, but you will need your PIN to change any setting.
This is a keyboard app. Locking it can make typing difficult, including when you enter your PIN.
Choose which apps need your PIN.
Detects which app is open so it can ask for your PIN. It does not read what is on the screen.
To lock an app, this app needs to know when it opens. Android only allows that through an Accessibility service.
It notices which app has come to the front, and shows the lock screen if you chose to protect that app.
It does not read anything on your screen, record what you type or do, or use the internet. This app has no network access, and nothing leaves your device.
If the switch is greyed out
On Android 13 and newer, an app installed from a file is restricted. Open App info, tap the three-dot menu, choose "Allow restricted settings", then try again.
Only when the screen turns off
Enter your current PIN, then choose a new one.

Everything stays on this device. This app has no internet access, no accounts, no analytics and no ads, and it sends nothing anywhere. Your PIN is never saved; only a check value is kept, protected by a key in the Android Keystore. The list of apps you protect is saved on this device and is not encrypted, because app names are not secret. The Accessibility service only sees which app is open. It does not read your screen.
Removes your PIN, fingerprint unlock, protected apps and settings. You will set up the app again from the start.
Enter your PIN to continue with erasing all data.
This removes your PIN, fingerprint unlock, protected apps and settings from this device. It cannot be undone, and protected apps will no longer be locked.
Some data could not be erased. Try again.
Enter your current PIN to continue.
Choose a PIN different from your current one.
Use your new PIN from now on. Fingerprint unlock keeps working.
Takes a photo with the front camera after repeated wrong PINs and saves it to your gallery.
The 2nd wrong PIN in a row
The 3rd wrong PIN in a row
The 5th wrong PIN in a row

Photos are saved in the Pictures folder, so apps that can see your photos, and a cloud gallery backup such as Google Photos, can see or upload them. This app itself never uploads anything. Android 12 and newer shows a camera indicator while the photo is taken, and some regions force a shutter sound.
Permission was not granted, so intruder selfie stays off.
Enter your PIN to turn on intruder selfie.
Unlock with a fingerprint instead of typing your PIN. Your PIN always works.
This device has no fingerprint sensor, so only the PIN is used.
Add a fingerprint in your device settings to use this.
Fingerprint is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
A security update is needed before fingerprint can be used.
Fingerprint unlock is not supported on this device.
Could not turn on fingerprint unlock. Try again.
Enter your PIN to turn on fingerprint unlock.
Too many attempts. Try again later.
